steps.title: Subset & self-host Google Fonts
steps.description: The Google Fonts woff2 payload is 3,860 KiB (75%+ of total page weight). Subset to Latin + only needed weights, self-host locally to eliminate external DNS/TLS round trips. Partially done: axis range subsetted (24,400,0,0 instead of full 20..48,100..700,0..1,-50..200). Still pending: self-hosting.

steps.title: Defer Material Symbols font CSS
steps.description: The Google Fonts Material Symbols CSS loaded via <link> in layout.tsx <head> is render-blocking. Loaded dynamically via ClientLayout useEffect with media="print" fallback + subsetted axis range.

steps.title: Inline critical CSS for above-the-fold content
steps.description: 3 CSS chunks (bc8470f73e47345d.css, ac8b093.css, aaf0bb1927b91dc7.css) block rendering for 19.6s on mobile. Extract critical above-the-fold styles and inline them in <head>.

steps.title: Defer non-critical CSS
steps.description: 44 KiB of unused CSS across the 3 chunks. Load non-critical CSS asynchronously (media="print" onload="this.media='all'" pattern).

steps.title: Enable Next.js image optimization
steps.description: Removed images.unoptimized: true from next.config.js. Next.js image optimization (sharp resizing, WebP/AVIF conversion, responsive srcSet) is now enabled.

steps.title: Resize oversized images to display dimensions
steps.description: Images resized: underHero 1920→1440px, missionarea 1000→600px, logos 917→400px / 924→400px. Portfolio images re-encoded with sharp (quality 80). ~88K total disk savings, larger transfer savings with Next.js optimization generating responsive WebP/AVIF.

steps.title: Preload LCP image with fetchpriority='high'
steps.description: Added <link rel="preload" as="image" fetchPriority="high"> for underHero.webp in layout.tsx <head>. Combined with priority={true} on the Image component for fastest LCP discovery.

steps.title: Fix incorrect image aspect ratios
steps.description: underHero.webp (displayed 0.87 vs actual 1.50) and logos/portfolio images all have wrong aspect ratios. Use object-fit: cover with properly sized containers, or regenerate images at correct display aspect ratios.
steps.estimatedSavings: Fixes Best Practices score, visual quality

steps.title: Ensure LCP image does not use 'loading=lazy'
steps.description: Verify underHero.webp does not have loading=lazy. Currently uses priority={true} in Next.js Image component which should set loading=eager, but confirm.

steps.title: Configure build to skip legacy polyfills
steps.description: 14 KiB of polyfills (Array.prototype.at, flat, flatMap, Object.fromEntries, Object.hasOwn, String.trimEnd/trimStart) are unnecessary for modern browsers. Update browserslist/target config.

steps.title: Code-split heavy JavaScript chunks
steps.description: chunks/a443e665....js (66.9 KiB, 21.5 KiB unused) and chunks/f83dccd61d1fecb4.js (31.9 KiB, 31.9 KiB unused) carry significant dead code. Implement dynamic imports for non-critical components.

steps.title: Defer Google Tag Manager loading
steps.description: GTM is 176 KiB with 225ms main thread time. Load it after user interaction or use Partytown to offload to a web worker.

steps.title: Eliminate forced reflows in JavaScript
steps.description: chunks/a443e665....js:2:8066 causes 62ms forced reflow (mobile). Likely Wow.js or scroll handler reading offsetWidth after DOM mutations. Investigate and debounce/batch reads.

steps.title: Purge unused CSS (Bootstrap + custom)
steps.description: 44 KiB unused CSS across chunks bc8470f73e47345d.css and aaf0bb1927b91dc7.css. Most is likely unused Bootstrap. Configure PurgeCSS in the build pipeline.

steps.title: Fix non-composited animations (44-50 elements)
steps.description: Animating color and border-color triggers expensive repaints. Switch to composited properties (transform, opacity) for animations across Swiper overlays, accordions, footer links, etc.

steps.title: Add Content Security Policy (CSP) header
steps.description: No CSP found in enforcement mode (High severity). Add CSP via next.config.js headers() or vercel.json to mitigate XSS attacks.

steps.title: Fix HSTS (add includeSubDomains + preload)
steps.description: HSTS header is missing includeSubDomains and preload directives (Medium severity). Add both.

steps.title: Add COOP, X-Frame-Options, and Trusted Types headers
steps.description: Missing Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and Trusted Types CSP directive (all High severity). Add all three.

steps.title: Add aria-labels to social media links
steps.description: Facebook and Instagram links in footer (and side menu button on desktop) lack discernible names. Add aria-label="Facebook" etc.

steps.title: Fix heading hierarchy
steps.description: Headings skip levels (h6 → h4 → h5 → h6 → h5). Restructure to maintain sequential descending order (h1 → h2 → h3 → h4).

steps.title: Fix layout shift from web fonts (CLS 0.002)
steps.description: Desktop CLS of 0.002 is caused by web font swap. Add explicit font-size-adjust fallback or set min-height on navbar to prevent shift.

steps.title: Reduce DOM size (439 elements)
steps.description: Total DOM elements is 439 with depth of 12. Simplify deeply nested Bootstrap grid structures and reduce unnecessary wrapper divs.

steps.title: Break up long main-thread tasks
steps.description: 6 long tasks found on mobile (longest: 154ms). Use requestIdleCallback, code splitting, and setTimeout/yield to break up execution.

steps.title: Improve Agentic Browsing score (1/2 → 2/2)
steps.description: Fix accessibility tree issues (same as 3.2.1) plus add llms.txt file and validate structured data with Schema.org testing tool.

steps.title: Verify and validate structured data
steps.description: Run Structured Data Testing Tool to validate current Schema.org markup. Add Organization, LocalBusiness, and Service schemas if missing.

steps.title: Improve cache headers for static assets
steps.description: Cloudflare email-decode.min.js has only 2-day cache TTL. Increase cache lifetimes for immutable assets in vercel.json or Cloudflare config.

quickWins.title: Enable Next.js image optimization
quickWins.action: Remove `images.unoptimized: true` from next.config.js and regenerate all images

quickWins.title: Preload LCP image with fetchpriority='high'

quickWins.action: Limit to Latin subset + only needed weights; self-host locally

quickWins.title: Defer Material Symbols CSS
quickWins.action: Use non-blocking CSS load pattern for the Material Symbols stylesheet
